cases.prompt: Add Somia monitoring to this custom Python agent.
cases.expected: Uses start_run + typed spans (not SomiaCallbackHandler or somia[langgraph]). Raw SomiaTrace + log_run only as a low-level escape hatch.

cases.prompt: Instrument this agent with client.log_run and SomiaTrace.
cases.expected: Passes trace.to_dict() not the object; sets eval-eligible top-level input/output; uses SUCCESS/FAILED on log_run and OK/ERROR on the trace; prefers dict I/O.

cases.prompt: Add Somia monitoring to this LangGraph agent whose state has many keys (query, messages, docs, scratchpad, final_answer).
cases.expected: Does not log the full state. Asks or proposes eval-eligible mapping (e.g. query in, final_answer out) plus debug-useful retrieve/LLM spans (doc ids not full docs); uses root_input_mapper/root_output_mapper or equivalent log_run fields.

cases.prompt: Add Somia log_run to this function def reply(question: str) -> str.
cases.expected: Proceeds without asking; uses question as eval-eligible input and the string reply as scorable output.

cases.prompt: Add Somia monitoring to a multi-step agent (retrieve then answer).
cases.expected: Proposes or adds debug-useful spans for key steps, not root-only I/O only; keeps run input/output eval-eligible.

cases.prompt: We already log query/final_answer with Somia. Add a local client.eval.
cases.expected: agent_fn uses the same input shape as monitored input; does not invent a conflicting contract.

cases.prompt: Add Somia to this LangGraph agent that uses graph.invoke.
cases.expected: Adds SomiaCallbackHandler; merges callbacks into existing config; does not also call log_run on the same path.

cases.prompt: Instrument our async LangGraph ainvoke path with Somia.
cases.expected: Keeps ainvoke; merges callbacks; does not convert to sync invoke.

cases.prompt: Log Somia runs for our graph.astream usage.
cases.expected: Preserves streaming; uses callback handler; does not collect the stream solely for logging unless asked.

cases.prompt: Wire Somia into this LangGraph app that already has callbacks.
cases.expected: Appends Somia handler; does not replace config or drop thread_id.

cases.prompt: Add Somia monitoring.
cases.expected: If SomiaCallbackHandler or log_run already present on the path, verifies/repairs instead of duplicating.

cases.prompt: Run a Somia evaluation of this agent against our dataset.
cases.expected: Uses client.eval with existing dataset/profile IDs; does not rewrite observability unless also requested; does not invent CRUD for criteria/sets.

cases.prompt: Integrate Somia monitoring.
cases.expected: Documents SOMIA_API_KEY and SOMIA_WORKSPACE_ID in .env.example; does not invent a real secret.

cases.prompt: Explain how this StateGraph works.
cases.expected: Skill should not drive Somia installation; answer is about the graph only.

cases.prompt: After logging a run, attach thumbs-up feedback with a short comment to the Somia trace.
cases.expected: Uses result trace_id; client.traces.feedback.create for text/status; then feedback.update with score_type=boolean and score=1; does not pass scores to create.

cases.prompt: We have a CSV of past agent prompts, responses, and thumbs labels. Upload them into Somia.
cases.expected: Batch log_run with eval-eligible input/output, provenance metadata, and idempotency_key per row; attaches feedback via create+update when labels present; skips feedback when trace_id missing on idempotent replay; does not use SomiaCallbackHandler.

cases.prompt: Upload historical interactions that only have prompt and response — no span trees.
cases.expected: Uploads via log_run with top-level I/O; uses run-only or a minimal root agent span; does not invent a fake multi-step span tree.

cases.prompt: This orchestrator calls another Somia-hosted pipeline. Nest the child run in the parent Monitor trace.
cases.expected: Uses start_run on the parent (not SomiaCallbackHandler for the composing hop); calls link_child_pipeline_run inside the child-call span with the hosted session_id; does not use nested start_run as a second root; does not hand-build Span.add_link dicts.

cases.prompt: Agent A calls agent B in the same Python process. Log both as Somia runs.
cases.expected: Does not treat nested start_run as composition (inner shares the outer run). Either one root run with spans, or two agents each with their own start_run/log_run plus link_child_pipeline_run + caller_*.

cases.prompt: Run a local Somia eval. Our dataset examples use {q, ticket} but agent_fn expects {question, locale}.
cases.expected: Keeps agent_fn as-is; passes mapping_input and/or input_fields on client.eval; does not apply mapping on server eval; prints mapping_coverage.

cases.prompt: We already have a list of {input, output} dicts. Score them with Somia eval — do not re-run the agent.
cases.expected: Uses client.eval(runs=...) with no agent_fn; does not pass mapping_input; does not invent validation-set CRUD.

cases.prompt: Run a server-side Somia eval of our hosted pipeline and remap dataset fields with mapping_input.
cases.expected: Does not pass mapping_input on server eval (local-only). Uses set_ids/dataset_id without agent_fn.
